body_lead: AI, welfare and ‘super app’: Vijay’s ‘25th century governance’ pitch to Tamil Nadu voters Vijay alleged that people are often made to run from office to office not because of documentation issues, but due to bribery. He said such a system cannot be called governance, but rather harassment, and promised to dismantle it. Synopsis: TVK chief Vijay on Sunday, 12 April, outlined a “25th century good governance” model, promising automated welfare delivery and time-bound public services.
